name: cycle-retrospective
description: Builds a retrospective for one tracker cycle (the last finished one, the current one, or a cycle you name): planned vs completed, work added mid-cycle and what spilled into the next cycle, with every number computed in code. For each spilled issue it looks for the stated reason in the issue's comments and in chat, and shows a reason only with a verbatim quote; otherwise it says no reason was found. It never blames a person. It ends with discussion prompts picked by fixed rules, and posts the retro to a chat channel only when you name one and approve that exact text. Not a sprint planner, not a status report and not a per-person performance tool.

skills.name: Cycle retrospective
skills.description: For one tracker cycle: planned vs completed, scope added mid-cycle, spilled work with evidence-backed reasons (a verbatim quote or no reason found), shipped list and discussion prompts; optionally posted to a chat channel you name, after you approve it.
examples: Why did work spill in cycle 24 for Platform?
Retro for the current cycle and post it to #eng-retro
